longDescription:
Visual Studio Code is Microsoft's extensible source-code editor with integrated debugging, source control, terminal access, language intelligence, remote development features, and a large extension ecosystem.

The stable release channel is installed from Microsoft's official Visual Studio Code repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'code' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-vscode.asc' 'https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-vscode.asc'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code
Suites: stable
Components: main
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft-vscode.asc
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'code'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'code' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

rm -f -- '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list'
apt-get clean
